.github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.ym.name: copilot-setup-steps.yml
.github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.ym.source_code:
name: Copilot Setup Steps

# Public-repo override. GitHub blocks
# self-hosted runners on public repos, so the org-default Copilot runner
# (labeled `linux-x64`, self-hosted) would queue a public repo's review ~24h
# and then cancel it. This file pins Copilot code review + coding agent to a
# GitHub-hosted Ubuntu x64 runner (free for public repos) by declaring the
# `copilot-setup-steps` job's `runs-on` — GitHub reads that to pick the runner.
#
# `"on":` is quoted to satisfy `yaml[truthy]` (yamllint + ansible-lint): YAML 1.1
# folds bare `on` into the boolean `On`. GitHub Actions and actionlint accept
# both forms.
"on": workflow_dispatch

jobs:
  # Copilot setup steps have a 59-minute platform limit
  copilot-setup-steps:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 59
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6

.github/workflows/standards.yml::standar.name: standards.yml
.github/workflows/standards.yml::standar.source_code:
# Push, schedule and manual jobs (from @rubio-enterprises/standards; this repository owns it). Each
# job runs only where the file that embodies it exists. GitHub does not allow hashFiles() in a
# job-level `if`, so the `files` job reports which of those files exist.
name: standards

"on":
  push:
    branches: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 9 * * 1"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  files:
    runs-on: ${{ fromJSON(vars.RUNNERS || '{}').small || fromJSON('["ubuntu-slim"]') }}
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      release-please: ${{ steps.files.outputs.release-please }}
      image: ${{ steps.files.outputs.image }}
      codewiki: ${{ steps.files.outputs.codewiki }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            release-please-config.json
            .github/.devcontainer/devcontainer.json
            docs/codewiki/metadata.json
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
      - id: files
        run: |
          for pair in release-please=release-please-config.json \
            image=.github/.devcontainer/devcontainer.json codewiki=docs/codewiki/metadata.json; do
            if [ -f "${pair#*=}" ]; then echo "${pair%%=*}=true" >>"$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi
          done

  release-please:
    needs: files
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && needs.files.outputs.release-please == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    uses: Rubio-Enterprises/.github/.github/workflows/release-please.yml@main
    secrets: inherit

  repository-image:
    needs: files
    if: github.event_name != 'schedule' && needs.files.outputs.image == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
    uses: Rubio-Enterprises/.github/.github/workflows/repository-image.yml@main

  codewiki-pages:
    needs: files
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && needs.files.outputs.codewiki == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pages: write
      id-token: write
    uses: Rubio-Enterprises/.github/.github/workflows/codewiki-pages.yml@main

  trufflehog:
    if: github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    uses: Rubio-Enterprises/.github/.github/workflows/secret-scan.yml@main
    with:
      mode: trufflehog

.github/workflows/test-gate.yml::test-ga.name: test-gate.yml
.github/workflows/test-gate.yml::test-ga.source_code:
# Test Gate (from @rubio-enterprises/standards; this repository owns it). The `test-gate` job is a
# required status check. It runs each Lifecycle Task this repository defines (typecheck, build,
# test, e2e) and, for test and e2e, requires JUnit reports under reports/test/ (junit.xml, or one
# per package) with at least one test case and no failures, so a suite that runs nothing cannot
# pass. Change runs-on, add services or setup steps as the repository needs; keep the job name.
# An Opt-out (STANDARDS_TEST_GATE = "off" in mise.toml) passes it with a notice.
name: test-gate

"on":
  pull_request:
  merge_group:

permissions:
  contents: read
  packages: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.sha }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  # Users run the plugins' hooks on macOS (bash 3.2 at /bin/bash), so the suite runs there too.
  # Not a required check itself: test-gate fails when this job does.
  tests-macos:
    name: tests / macos
    runs-on: ${{ fromJSON(vars.RUNNERS || '{}').macos || fromJSON('["macos-26"]') }}
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: jdx/mise-action@c2a87611a18de5b3828c5652fe268e992400cb5c # v4
        with:
          install: false
      - run: mise run setup
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      - run: mise run test

  test-gate:
    name: test-gate
    needs: [tests-macos]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
    runs-on: ${{ fromJSON(vars.RUNNERS || '{}').small || fromJSON('["ubuntu-slim"]') }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Require the macOS run
        env:
          MACOS_RESULT: ${{ needs.tests-macos.result }}
        run: |
          test "$MACOS_RESULT" = success || { echo "::error::tests / macos: $MACOS_RESULT"; exit 1; }
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: jdx/mise-action@c2a87611a18de5b3828c5652fe268e992400cb5c # v4
        with:
          install: false
      - name: Install the standards package, the tools and the dependencies
        run: mise run setup
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      - name: Run the Lifecycle Tasks this repository defines
        run: |
          if [ "$(mise exec -- printenv STANDARDS_TEST_GATE || true)" = off ]; then
            echo "::notice::Test Gate Opt-out: STANDARDS_TEST_GATE = off in mise.toml"
            exit 0
          fi
          for task in typecheck build test e2e; do
            if ! mise tasks info "$task" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "no $task task"; continue; fi
            rm -rf reports/test
            echo "::group::mise run $task"
            mise run "$task"
            echo "::endgroup::"
            case $task in test | e2e)
              # reports/test/junit.xml, or one report per package in a monorepo.
              if [ -z "$(find reports/test -name '*.xml' 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
                echo "::error::$task wrote no JUnit report under reports/test/"
                exit 1
              fi
              junit() { find reports/test -name '*.xml' -exec cat {} + | { grep -oE "$1" || true; } | wc -l; }
              cases=$(junit '<testcase[ >]')
              failed=$(junit '<(failure|error)[ >/]')
              echo "$task: $cases test cases, $failed failures or errors"
              if [ "$cases" -eq 0 ] || [ "$failed" -ne 0 ]; then
                echo "::error::$task: the JUnit proof needs at least one test case and no failures"
                exit 1
              fi
            esac
          done

lefthook.override.yml::lefthook.override.source_code:
# Patches to the @rubio-enterprises/standards Checks, loaded after the shared file so its fields win
# (an Exclusion). Name a shared job and set only the fields to change; a list you set replaces the
# shared list; a `run` you set wins over the shared command in every later release. Fixers are
# patched inside the `fixers` group. Globs use doublestar (`**/` = zero or more directories).
# For example:
#
#   pre-commit:
#     exclude_tags: [rubocop]   # the upstream Ruby scripts are not ours; <issue link>
#     jobs:
#       - name: fixers
#         group:
#           jobs:
#             - name: biome
#               glob: "**/*.{json,jsonc}"   # this repository formats JS/TS with its own tools
#
# No Check validates this file: confirm a patch with `lefthook dump`.

pre-commit:
  # The deliberately malformed LSP fixtures are test data, not shell, YAML or JSON source.
  exclude:
    - "tests/fixtures/**"

lefthook.yml::lefthook.yml.name: lefthook.yml
lefthook.yml::lefthook.yml.source_code:
# Git hooks, run by lefthook; `mise run setup` installs them. The Checks come from
# @rubio-enterprises/standards, installed into .standards/. Later files win: this file, then the
# shared Checks, then lefthook.override.yml (patches and Exclusions).
extends:
  - .standards/node_modules/@rubio-enterprises/standards/lefthook/standards.yml
  - lefthook.override.yml

pre-commit:
  # This repository's own checks go here as more jobs, under names the shared file does not use.
  jobs:
    # lefthook skips a missing extends file without a word, so check that the package is there.
    - name: standards installed
      tags: [standards]
      run: test -f .standards/node_modules/@rubio-enterprises/standards/lefthook/standards.yml
      fail_text: "@rubio-enterprises/standards is not installed: run mise run setup"

commit-msg:
  jobs:
    - name: standards installed
      tags: [standards]
      run: test -f .standards/node_modules/@rubio-enterprises/standards/lefthook/standards.yml
      fail_text: "@rubio-enterprises/standards is not installed: run mise run setup"

# Keep .standards/ on the latest Standards Release (or the Release Pin) after anything that can
# move the checkout. Never fails the git command: an untrusted or offline checkout says what to run.
post-checkout:
  jobs:
    - name: standards install
      run: &install >-
        mise run --quiet standards:install
        || echo "standards: could not refresh .standards/ (mise trust? network?); run mise run setup" >&2
post-merge:
  jobs:
    - name: standards install
      run: *install
post-rewrite:
  jobs:
    - name: standards install
      run: *install

mise.toml::mise.toml.name: mise.toml
mise.toml::mise.toml.source_code:
# This repository's tools and tasks. The Checks, their tool pins and the Conformance Tasks (check,
# check:pr, fmt) come from @rubio-enterprises/standards, which `mise run setup` installs into
# .standards/ and mise loads through .config/mise/conf.d/standards.toml.
min_version = "2026.10.19"

[env]
# STANDARDS_VERSION = "1.4.2"  # Release Pin: hold this release while the latest breaks the repository; <issue link>
# STANDARDS_TEST_GATE = "off"  # Opt-out of the Test Gate; <reason>

[tools]
node = "24.22.1"

# The plugins' Node proxies have no npm dependencies; the Bash harness needs node, jq and
# shellcheck, which mise provides.
[tasks.test]
description = "Run the test harness, with the JUnit report the Test Gate checks"
run = "JUNIT_REPORT=reports/test/junit.xml bash tests/run.sh"

[tasks.live-setup]
description = "Install the LSP servers the live cases drive (they skip without them)"
# The cue and regal installers fall back to ~/.local/bin and then check PATH.
run = '''
set -e
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
bash pyright/hooks/check-pyright.sh
bash bash-language-server/hooks/check-bash-language-server.sh
bash vtsls/hooks/check-vtsls.sh
bash cue-lsp/hooks/check-cue.sh
bash regal-lsp/hooks/check-regal.sh
'''

[tasks.setup]
description = "Install the standards package, its tools and the git hooks, then every setup:* task"
depends = ["standards:install"]
# `mise install` only when something is missing: on a machine with many tracked configs a no-op
# install still rebuilds every shim.
run = ['test -z "$(mise ls --missing)" || mise install', "mise exec -- lefthook install"]
# This repository's own setup steps (dependencies the Checks or Lifecycle Tasks need) are setup:*
# tasks; none is fine.
depends_post = [{ task = "setup:*", optional = true }]

[tasks."standards:install"]
description = "Install the latest Standards Release (or the STANDARDS_VERSION Release Pin) into .standards/"
run = '''npm install --prefix .standards --no-save --prefer-online --fetch-retries=0 --no-audit --no-fund --ignore-scripts --loglevel=error "--@rubio-enterprises:registry=${STANDARDS_REGISTRY:-https://npm.pkg.github.com}" '--//npm.pkg.github.com/:_authToken=${NODE_AUTH_TOKEN}' "@rubio-enterprises/standards@${STANDARDS_VERSION:-latest}"'''

# Lifecycle Tasks (test, typecheck, build, e2e) are this repository's own. `test` and `e2e` write
# reports/test/junit.xml; the Test Gate runs each one that exists.
[hooks]
enter = "test -f .standards/node_modules/@rubio-enterprises/standards/mise/standards.toml || echo 'standards: not installed; run mise run setup' >&2"

ruff.toml::ruff.toml.name: ruff.toml
ruff.toml::ruff.toml.source_code:
# Ruff settings. The shared floor comes from @rubio-enterprises/standards; add this repository's
# exceptions below in Ruff's own syntax (lint.extend-select, lint.extend-per-file-ignores,
# extend-exclude); a scalar such as target-version set here wins.
extend = ".standards/node_modules/@rubio-enterprises/standards/config/ruff.toml"

tombi.toml::tombi.toml.name: tombi.toml

# Tombi settings (from @rubio-enterprises/standards; Tombi cannot extend a shared file).
# No schema-driven key/array sorting or network-dependent formatting.
[schema]
enabled = false

treefmt.toml::treefmt.toml.name: treefmt.toml
treefmt.toml::treefmt.toml.source_code:
# treefmt bridge (from @rubio-enterprises/standards): lets coding agents and `treefmt <paths>`
# format exactly as the pre-commit Fixers do, by handing the paths to Lefthook.
tree-root-file = "treefmt.toml"
on-unmatched = "debug"

[formatter.lefthook]
command = "sh"
options = [
  "-c",
  '''
test -f .standards/node_modules/@rubio-enterprises/standards/lefthook/standards.yml || { echo "treefmt: @rubio-enterprises/standards is not installed: run mise run setup" >&2; exit 1; }
printf '%s\0' "$@" | mise exec -- lefthook run pre-commit --tag fixer --no-stage-fixed --no-fail-on-changes --no-auto-install --files-from-stdin
''',
  "--",
]
includes = ["*"]

bash-language-server/hooks/check-bash-la.name: check-bash-language-server.sh
bash-language-server/hooks/check-bash-la.source_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Check/install bash-language-server for Claude Code LSP plugin

BINARY="bash-language-server"
FORMULA="bash-language-server"
NPM_PACKAGE="bash-language-server"

# Every plugin launches its server through the Node proxy (lsp-proxy.js), so a
# usable session needs node on PATH even when the server binary is present.
if ! command -v node &>/dev/null; then
  echo "[$BINARY] node is required to run this plugin's LSP proxy but is not on PATH." >&2
  echo "[$BINARY] Install Node.js (e.g. brew install node), then restart the session." >&2
  exit 1
fi

if command -v "$BINARY" &>/dev/null; then
  exit 0
fi

# Determine install method: Homebrew first, npm fallback
if command -v brew &>/dev/null; then
  INSTALL_METHOD="brew"
  LOCK_FILE="/tmp/claude-lsp-brew.lock"
elif command -v npm &>/dev/null; then
  INSTALL_METHOD="npm"
  LOCK_FILE="/tmp/claude-lsp-npm.lock"
else
  echo "[$BINARY] Neither Homebrew nor npm found. Install one of them first."
  exit 1
fi

LOCK_TIMEOUT=120

do_install() {
  if [ "$INSTALL_METHOD" = "brew" ]; then
    echo "[$BINARY] Installing via Homebrew..."
    if brew install "$FORMULA"; then
      echo "[$BINARY] Installed successfully"
    else
      echo "[$BINARY] brew install failed"
      return 1
    fi
  else
    echo "[$BINARY] Installing via npm..."
    if npm install -g "$NPM_PACKAGE"; then
      echo "[$BINARY] Installed successfully"
    else
      echo "[$BINARY] npm install failed"
      return 1
    fi
  fi
}

# Serialized install (flock with mkdir fallback for macOS)
if command -v flock &>/dev/null; then
  (
    flock --timeout "$LOCK_TIMEOUT" 9 || {
      echo "[$BINARY] Lock timeout"
      exit 1
    }
    command -v "$BINARY" &>/dev/null && exit 0
    do_install
  ) 9>"$LOCK_FILE"
else
  waited=0
  while ! mkdir "$LOCK_FILE.d" 2>/dev/null; do
    if ((waited >= LOCK_TIMEOUT)); then
      echo "[$BINARY] Lock timeout"
      exit 1
    fi
    sleep 2
    ((waited += 2))
  done
  trap 'rmdir "$LOCK_FILE.d" 2>/dev/null' EXIT
  command -v "$BINARY" &>/dev/null || do_install
fi

if ! command -v "$BINARY" &>/dev/null; then
  echo "[$BINARY] Not in PATH after install. Install manually: brew install $FORMULA"
  exit 1
fi

cue-lsp/hooks/check-cue.sh::check-cue.sh.name: check-cue.sh
cue-lsp/hooks/check-cue.sh::check-cue.sh.source_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Check/install CUE CLI for Claude Code LSP plugin

BINARY="cue"
FORMULA="cue-lang/tap/cue"

# Every plugin launches its server through the Node proxy (lsp-proxy.js), so a
# usable session needs node on PATH even when the server binary is present.
# (cue is a Go binary — unlike the Node-based servers, its presence does not
# imply node exists.)
if ! command -v node &>/dev/null; then
  echo "[$BINARY] node is required to run this plugin's LSP proxy but is not on PATH." >&2
  echo "[$BINARY] Install Node.js (e.g. brew install node), then restart the session." >&2
  exit 1
fi

if command -v "$BINARY" &>/dev/null; then
  exit 0
fi

# Determine install method: Homebrew first, binary download fallback
if command -v brew &>/dev/null; then
  INSTALL_METHOD="brew"
  LOCK_FILE="/tmp/claude-lsp-brew.lock"
else
  INSTALL_METHOD="binary"
  LOCK_FILE="/tmp/claude-lsp-binary.lock"
fi

LOCK_TIMEOUT=120

do_install() {
  if [ "$INSTALL_METHOD" = "brew" ]; then
    echo "[$BINARY] Installing via Homebrew..."
    if brew install "$FORMULA"; then
      echo "[$BINARY] Installed successfully"
    else
      echo "[$BINARY] brew install failed"
      return 1
    fi
  else
    echo "[$BINARY] Installing binary from GitHub..."
    local arch
    case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) arch="amd64" ;;
    aarch64 | arm64) arch="arm64" ;;
    *)
      echo "[$BINARY] Unsupported architecture: $(uname -m)"
      return 1
      ;;
    esac

    local os
    os="$(uname -s | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
    local version="0.16.0"
    local url="https://github.com/cue-lang/cue/releases/download/v${version}/cue_v${version}_${os}_${arch}.tar.gz"
    local install_dir="${HOME}/.local/bin"
    local tmp_dir
    tmp_dir="$(mktemp -d)"

    mkdir -p "$install_dir"
    if curl -fsSL "$url" | tar xz -C "$tmp_dir"; then
      mv "$tmp_dir/cue" "$install_dir/cue"
      chmod +x "$install_dir/cue"
      echo "[$BINARY] Installed to $install_dir/cue"
    else
      echo "[$BINARY] Binary download failed"
      rm -rf "$tmp_dir"
      return 1
    fi

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Check/install Regal for Claude Code LSP plugin

BINARY="regal"
FORMULA="styrainc/tap/regal"

# Every plugin launches its server through the Node proxy (lsp-proxy.js), so a
# usable session needs node on PATH even when the server binary is present.
# (regal is a Go binary — unlike the Node-based servers, its presence does not
# imply node exists.)
if ! command -v node &>/dev/null; then
  echo "[$BINARY] node is required to run this plugin's LSP proxy but is not on PATH." >&2
  echo "[$BINARY] Install Node.js (e.g. brew install node), then restart the session." >&2
  exit 1
fi

if command -v "$BINARY" &>/dev/null; then
  exit 0
fi

# Determine install method: Homebrew on macOS, binary download on Linux
case "$(uname -s)" in
Darwin)
  if command -v brew &>/dev/null; then
    INSTALL_METHOD="brew"
    LOCK_FILE="/tmp/claude-lsp-brew.lock"
  else
    INSTALL_METHOD="binary"
    LOCK_FILE="/tmp/claude-lsp-binary.lock"
  fi
  ;;
*)
  INSTALL_METHOD="binary"
  LOCK_FILE="/tmp/claude-lsp-binary.lock"
  ;;
esac

LOCK_TIMEOUT=120

do_install() {
  if [ "$INSTALL_METHOD" = "brew" ]; then
    echo "[$BINARY] Installing via Homebrew..."
    if brew install "$FORMULA"; then
      echo "[$BINARY] Installed successfully"
    else
      echo "[$BINARY] brew install failed"
      return 1
    fi
  else
    echo "[$BINARY] Installing binary from GitHub..."
    local arch
    case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) arch="x86_64" ;;
    aarch64 | arm64) arch="arm64" ;;
    *)
      echo "[$BINARY] Unsupported architecture: $(uname -m)"
      return 1
      ;;
    esac

    local os
    case "$(uname -s)" in
    Linux) os="Linux" ;;
    Darwin) os="Darwin" ;;
    *)
      echo "[$BINARY] Unsupported OS: $(uname -s)"
      return 1
      ;;
    esac

    local version="0.39.0"
    local url="https://github.com/open-policy-agent/regal/releases/download/v${version}/regal_${os}_${arch}"
    local install_dir="${HOME}/.local/bin"

    mkdir -p "$install_dir"
    if curl -fsSL -o "$install_dir/regal" "$url"; then
      chmod +x "$install_dir/regal"
      echo "[$BINARY] Installed to $install_dir/regal"
    else
      echo "[$BINARY] Binary download failed"
      return 1
    fi
  fi
}

# Serialized install (flock with mkdir fallback for macOS)
if command -v flock &>/dev/null; then
  (
    flock --timeout "$LOCK_TIMEOUT" 9 || {
      echo "[$BINARY] Lock timeout"
      exit 1
    }
    command -v "$BINARY" &>/dev/null && exit 0
    do_install
  ) 9>"$LOCK_FILE"
else
  waited=0
  while ! mkdir "$LOCK_FILE.d" 2>/dev/null; do
    if ((waited >= LOCK_TIMEOUT)); then
      echo "[$BINARY] Lock timeout"
      exit 1
    fi
    sleep 2
    ((waited += 2))
  done
  trap 'rmdir "$LOCK_FILE.d" 2>/dev/null' EXIT
  command -v "$BINARY" &>/dev/null || do_install
fi

if ! command -v "$BINARY" &>/dev/null; then
  echo "[$BINARY] Not in PATH after install. Install manually: brew install $FORMULA"
  exit 1
fi

.github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.ym.name: copilot-setup-steps
.github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.ym.source_code:
copilot-setup-steps:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 59
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6

.github/workflows/standards.yml::files.name: files
.github/workflows/standards.yml::files.source_code:
files:
    runs-on: ${{ fromJSON(vars.RUNNERS || '{}').small || fromJSON('["ubuntu-slim"]') }}
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      release-please: ${{ steps.files.outputs.release-please }}
      image: ${{ steps.files.outputs.image }}
      codewiki: ${{ steps.files.outputs.codewiki }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            release-please-config.json
            .github/.devcontainer/devcontainer.json
            docs/codewiki/metadata.json
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
      - id: files
        run: |
          for pair in release-please=release-please-config.json \
            image=.github/.devcontainer/devcontainer.json codewiki=docs/codewiki/metadata.json; do
            if [ -f "${pair#*=}" ]; then echo "${pair%%=*}=true" >>"$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi
          done

.github/workflows/standards.yml::release.name: release-please
.github/workflows/standards.yml::release.source_code:
release-please:
    needs: files
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && needs.files.outputs.release-please == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    uses: Rubio-Enterprises/.github/.github/workflows/release-please.yml@main
    secrets: inherit

.github/workflows/standards.yml::reposit.name: repository-image
.github/workflows/standards.yml::reposit.source_code:
repository-image:

.github/workflows/test-gate.yml::tests-m.name: tests-macos
.github/workflows/test-gate.yml::tests-m.source_code:
tests-macos:
    name: tests / macos
    runs-on: ${{ fromJSON(vars.RUNNERS || '{}').macos || fromJSON('["macos-26"]') }}
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: jdx/mise-action@c2a87611a18de5b3828c5652fe268e992400cb5c # v4
        with:
          install: false
      - run: mise run setup
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      - run: mise run test

.github/workflows/test-gate.yml::test-ga.name: test-gate
.github/workflows/test-gate.yml::test-ga.source_code:
test-gate:
    name: test-gate
    needs: [tests-macos]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
    runs-on: ${{ fromJSON(vars.RUNNERS || '{}').small || fromJSON('["ubuntu-slim"]') }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Require the macOS run
        env:
          MACOS_RESULT: ${{ needs.tests-macos.result }}
        run: |
          test "$MACOS_RESULT" = success || { echo "::error::tests / macos: $MACOS_RESULT"; exit 1; }
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: jdx/mise-action@c2a87611a18de5b3828c5652fe268e992400cb5c # v4
        with:
          install: false
      - name: Install the standards package, the tools and the dependencies
        run: mise run setup
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      - name: Run the Lifecycle Tasks this repository defines
        run: |
          if [ "$(mise exec -- printenv STANDARDS_TEST_GATE || true)" = off ]; then
            echo "::notice::Test Gate Opt-out: STANDARDS_TEST_GATE = off in mise.toml"
            exit 0
          fi
          for task in typecheck build test e2e; do
            if ! mise tasks info "$task" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "no $task task"; continue; fi
            rm -rf reports/test
            echo "::group::mise run $task"
            mise run "$task"
            echo "::endgroup::"
            case $task in test | e2e)
              # reports/test/junit.xml, or one report per package in a monorepo.
              if [ -z "$(find reports/test -name '*.xml' 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
                echo "::error::$task wrote no JUnit report under reports/test/"
                exit 1
              fi
              junit() { find reports/test -name '*.xml' -exec cat {} + | { grep -oE "$1" || true; } | wc -l; }
              cases=$(junit '<testcase[ >]')
              failed=$(junit '<(failure|error)[ >/]')
              echo "$task: $cases test cases, $failed failures or errors"
              if [ "$cases" -eq 0 ] || [ "$failed" -ne 0 ]; then
                echo "::error::$task: the JUnit proof needs at least one test case and no failures"
                exit 1
              fi
            esac
          done
